findings.title: VIP Platinum 20% Discount Rate
findings.message: DiscountService.TIER_DISCOUNTS[CustomerTier.VIP_PLATINUM] is configured to 0.10 (10%) instead of required 0.20 (20%).

findings.title: Defensive Voucher Validation
findings.message: Missing validation for voucher.is_active and voucher.max_discount_amount cap. Inactive vouchers are erroneously applied.

findings.title: Unit Test Coverage & Assertions
findings.message: tests/test_discount_service.py test_vip_platinum_discount_legacy still asserts obsolete $90.00 outcome. Missing inactive voucher test cases.

findings.title: Structured Audit Logging
findings.message: No structured financial audit log emitted on successful discount calculation.
